output.questionKn: ಮರಳಲ್ಲಿ ಬರೆಸ್ತಿದ್ದಿರಿ ಅಂದ್ರಿ. ಆ ಮಗುವಿಗೆ ಅದನ್ನು ಹೇಗೆ ಮಾಡಿಸಿದಿರಿ? ನೀವು ಮಗುವಿಗೆ ಹೇಳಿದ ಮಾತುಗಳನ್ನೇ ಹೇಳಿ.
output.questionEn: You said you had the child write in sand. How did you get the child to do it? Please tell me the very words you said to the child.
output.why: To draw out the specific method and the master's exact words, as a follow-up on the letters story.
